items.title: Nvidia, Dell Back AI Cloud Startup Volta at $2.4 Billion Value
items.summary: (Bloomberg) -- Volta Infra Holdings Ltd., a new artificial intelligence cloud company, has raised $300 million in venture funding and secured an additional $5 billion worth of financing to help a wider mix of technology companies gain access to costly AI chips. The funding, set to be announced Tuesday, values Volta at $2.4 billion, and was co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and Altimeter Capital. Nvidia Corp. and Michael Dell also participated. items.title: How to Play the Flood of AI Bonds
items.summary: Recent earnings reports by the so-called hyperscalers have driven expectations even higher for their collective AI spending plans.  Goldman Sachs credit strategists estimate that approximately $400 billion in highly rated investment-grade bonds could be issued directly by hyperscalers globally in 2027.  A group of investment-grade hyperscalers tracked by Barclays credit strategists includes  Alphabet Amazon.com Meta Platforms Microsoft Oracle  and  SpaceX.  The spread offered by these companies’ bonds over benchmark Treasurys has widened by almost a quarter percentage point over the past month through July 30, according to tracking by Barclays.

items.title: Blackstone (BX) Buys HSBC’s Australian Loan Book And DarkVision Technologies
items.summary: HSBC has agreed to sell its Australian loan book to Blackstone, expanding Blackstone's presence in Australian credit markets. Blackstone has also acquired DarkVision Technologies, a company focused on advanced infrastructure inspection technology. Blackstone, traded as NYSE:BX, is adding two very different assets to its portfolio at the same time.
